desc:
A cozy village where you build the place you want to come back to.

🏡 Build a home: walls, roofs, stairs, furniture, wallpaper, gardens, ponds
🪓 Saw logs into planks, walls and doors at your Saw Station
🌱 Plant trees, fruit, vegetables, flowers and grain — they grow offline

🐑 Tame boar and sheep in the woods, and keep hens for fresh eggs
🎣 Craft a fishing rod and hunt for a rare Koi Carp
🍳 Cook hearty meals at stoves and ovens, and set them out on your table
🐝 Keep bees for wax and honey — sell it or use it
🍂 The village and trees change with the seasons
💰 Sell your harvest to the Market Trader for Amber Coins
📋 Take on Job quests whenever you want a bit of direction

No combat. No threat. Your farm keeps growing whether you're here or not.

🔔 Hit NOTIFY to catch seasonal updates first
